svg.title: A light-driven molecular clock
svg.desc: A six-reaction nuclear and cytoplasmic oscillator. Light modulates transcription. Nuclear mRNA is exported; cytoplasmic mRNA catalyzes protein production without being consumed. Protein is imported into the nucleus and represses transcription. Degradation occurs only for cytoplasmic mRNA and nuclear protein in this model.
svg.text: Periodic light modulates transcription in a delayed negative-feedback loop.
Model adapted from Wang & Peskin (2018), Physical Review E 97, 062416.
Arrows show reaction flow; the red bar denotes inhibition. The translation step does not consume mRNA.
